what_it_is: At first save in mountains near Citan's House. Fei is at max stats! 999 Health, full attack stats, ect. Finished game with save.

gamefaqs.section: PlayStation PS3 Virtual Memory Card Save (ZIP) (North America)

format: zip of 1 PS3 export(s) (.PSV): '\0VSP' header (signature, save name at 0x64), the save's blocks from 0x84 (8324 bytes); it holds 1 save(s), 1 for this game (BASLUS-006641)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/psx-card.py card.mcr PS3/EXPORT/PSV/BASLUS-0066431.PSV: puts the save(s) on a freshly formatted card, as MemcardRex imports a single save
